Context: DOB NOW workflow

The DOB NOW workflow indicates that DHCR data identifies at least one rent-controlled or rent-stabilized unit. The owner believes the building contains none but has not provided supporting documentation.

May the filing simply answer No to the rent-regulated-housing question?
rows.finding: The complete owner-attestation page is retrieved directly. A narrowly scoped known-source route could avoid paid source discovery; live correctness remains unconfirmed.

rows.question:
Context: DOB NOW workflow

An applicable NB or Alteration-CO GC filing for a newly erected single-family residence includes an Ancillary Dwelling Unit in the basement.

Which DOB NOW responses and document requirement follow?
rows.finding: The generic three-page ranking selects pages 10, 28 and 30 and omits the field-options page 29. The cellar probe also omits the conditional filing restriction on page 32. Do not enable a broad ADU shortcut without preserving related page coverage.
